metaTitle: Custom Poly Propylene Headwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene headwear for your team. Perfect for outdoor events and safety needs. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Poly propylene headwear is lightweight, breathable, and quick-drying, making it a top pick for outdoor events, construction sites, and promotional giveaways. Unlike cotton, it wicks moisture away to keep wearers comfortable in warm conditions. Ideal for custom embroidery or screen printing, these hats keep your logo visible while offering practical sun protection for your crew or event attendees.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene headwear with embroidered logo on a cap, ideal for outdoor events and safety teams.
